title: A Pin in the Pan
lines: Nan sat at a tin pan.
A pin is in the pan!
Tip it, Nan. Tip the pan.
The pin is in a tin.

questions.listenFor: A pin. The second line says so, and it ends with an exclamation mark.

questions.ask: Where does the pin end up?
questions.listenFor: In a tin. Let them find the fourth line and read it again.

questions.ask: Why do you think Nan put the pin in a tin?
questions.listenFor: Looking for the idea that a loose pin is not safe. "So no one sits on it" is exactly right.
